headline: Real weight-transfer drifting in a single HTML file
text:
We built an EV drifting game with realistic weight-transfer physics in a single HTML file.

Grip is a budget. Your battery is your health bar. Regen brake to survive.

Zero install, loads in 0.1s:
https://kreeda.games/drift/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A fast-paced 5-second looping GIF showing a slick high-speed drift in the rain biome, transitioning to a ghost replay and battery regen gauge meter bouncing up.
